scope: Individually compared alternate captures for a source-linked Blue Scholars WordPress post. Raw captures remain in recovery/raw and their immutable capture records remain in the recovery checkpoint.

records.decision: Same 2011 WordPress article and page style; 11 visible comments versus 7 in May; chosen as default for the /blog/ route because it is the later compatible capture.
Same article text and 11 comments; separate no-/blog/ source URL with an additional contest navigation item. Kept as its own route in the 2009 WordPress edition.
Same no-/blog/ route and template; alternate capture, not merged with the 2011 /blog/ route.
Distinct print-view route with two comments; retained as its own captured page.
Earliest retrieved /blog/ capture reviewed against July 2011: same article and old WordPress template, with 7 visible comments; retained as dated alternate, while July is the default /blog/ page.

method: Compared local capture timestamp, original URL, SHA-256, title, article text, visible comment count, image references, and navigation labels. The raw source bytes were not modified.
